title: DEF Dosing Unit Open Circuit
shortDescription: Open circuit detected in DEF injector solenoid on Final Tier 4 John Deere PowerTech engines.
fullDescription:
John Deere PowerTech PSS engines (4.5L, 6.8L, 9.0L, 13.5L) on 6R, 7R, 8R, 9R series tractors use Bosch SCR aftertreatment. SPN 3361 FMI 5 indicates the dosing valve solenoid circuit is open.

Ignoring will derate engine to 50 percent torque after 36 hours of operation per Tier 4 emissions law.

fixSteps.title: Connect Service ADVISOR
fixSteps.instruction: Pull active and stored faults, look at freeze frame.

fixSteps.title: Inspect dosing valve harness
fixSteps.instruction: Trace harness from valve to ECU side, repair chafe points.

fixSteps.title: Replace DEF dosing valve
fixSteps.instruction: Drain DEF lines, unbolt valve, install new with new gasket.

fixSteps.title: Run dosing test
fixSteps.instruction: Service ADVISOR DEF dosing test verifies spray pattern and pressure.

whenToCallPro: If 50 percent derate is engaged, dealer needed to clear inducement.
videoSearchQuery: John Deere SPN 3361 DEF dosing valve

faq.q: Will tractor still run during planting?
faq.a: Yes, until derate hours accumulate. Plan repair before 36 hours.

title: Engine Protection Torque Derate Active
shortDescription: Engine has derated due to a protection condition.
fullDescription:
Set when an upstream fault triggers protection mode. Common triggers: high coolant temp, low oil pressure, plugged air filter, or DEF inducement.

Diagnose the upstream fault first.

fixSteps.title: Pull all active codes
fixSteps.instruction: Identify root cause among parallel faults.

fixSteps.title: Check air filter
fixSteps.instruction: Pull primary and secondary air filters, replace if dirty.

faq.a: Once root cause is fixed, derate clears after a key cycle.

title: Cylinder 1 Injector Open Circuit
shortDescription: Open circuit in cylinder 1 injector solenoid.
fullDescription:
Common rail injectors on PowerTech engines log this when the ECU detects no current draw on the driver.

The affected cylinder drops, causing rough idle and a misfire.

fixSteps.title: Cylinder cutout test
fixSteps.instruction: Service ADVISOR cylinder cutout to confirm cylinder 1 not contributing.

fixSteps.title: Inspect under valve cover
fixSteps.instruction: Pull rocker cover, check harness pass-through and connector.

fixSteps.title: Replace injector and program trim code
fixSteps.instruction: Install new injector with O-rings, enter trim code via Service ADVISOR.

whenToCallPro: Trim code programming requires dealer software.

faq.a: No - additional damage and failed regens will follow.

title: DPF Differential Pressure High
fullDescription:
John Deere uses passive and active regen on Final Tier 4. SPN 3251 FMI 0 indicates the filter is loaded and a parked regen is needed.

If parked regen fails, ash service is required.

causes.cause: Failed regens due to DEF system

fixSteps.title: Run parked regen
fixSteps.instruction: Operator station regen menu, takes 30-45 minutes.

fixSteps.title: Diagnose if regen fails
fixSteps.instruction: Service ADVISOR for EGT, DEF dosing, and exhaust temp.

fixSteps.title: Send DPF for ash cleaning
fixSteps.instruction: Pull and ship to John Deere ash cleaning service after 5000 hours.

whenToCallPro: Ash cleaning is dealer or specialist.
videoSearchQuery: John Deere SPN 3251 DPF parked regen

faq.a: Yes, excessive idling without load is the main soot accumulator.

title: Engine Oil Pressure Low
shortDescription: Oil pressure below safe operating threshold.
fullDescription:
Critical fault. ECU triggers protection derate and possibly auto-shutdown. Stop tractor immediately.

Check oil level, oil pump, and pressure sender.

fixSteps.title: Check oil level cold
fixSteps.instruction: Park level, top off with John Deere Plus-50 II.

fixSteps.title: Verify with mechanical gauge
fixSteps.instruction: T into oil galley test port, compare to ECU reading.

fixSteps.title: Replace pressure sender
fixSteps.instruction: If mechanical reads good but ECU reads low, sender failed.

fixSteps.title: Internal engine inspection
fixSteps.instruction: If pressure truly low, drop pan to inspect oil pump and bearings.

videoSearchQuery: John Deere low oil pressure SPN 100

faq.a: No. Tow or transport. Driving with low oil pressure destroys bearings.

title: Engine Coolant Temperature High
fullDescription:
Tractor will protect itself with derate or shutdown. Common in summer with plugged radiator screens or when using GreenStar field traffic at high RPM with light load.

Clear screens and verify fan operation.

fixSteps.title: Stop and let cool
fixSteps.instruction: Do not open cap hot. Wait 30 minutes.

fixSteps.title: Verify reversing fan works
fixSteps.instruction: Many JD tractors have auto-reverse to clear chaff. Check operator menu cycle.

fixSteps.title: Replace thermostat
fixSteps.instruction: If level OK and screens clean, thermostat next.

faq.a: Yes, harvest chaff plugs screens within hours in dry conditions.

title: Fuel Delivery Pressure Low
shortDescription: Low-pressure fuel feed below required level.
fullDescription:
John Deere PowerTech needs adequate transfer pressure for the high-pressure pump. Plugged filters and air leaks are common, especially on used biodiesel.

Replace filters and prime.

fixSteps.title: Replace primary and secondary filters
fixSteps.instruction: Drain water separator, install new elements, prime via hand pump.

fixSteps.title: Test supply pressure
fixSteps.instruction: Tap test port, expect spec pressure with key on.

faq.a: B20 is JD-approved; higher blends can plug filters faster in cold.

title: Hydraulic System Pressure Not Responding
shortDescription: Hydraulic system not building commanded pressure.
fullDescription:
PFC hydraulic system on 7R/8R tractors. SPN 1077 FMI 7 indicates the pump is not responding to load demand.

Usually a stuck pressure compensation valve or contaminated oil.

fixSteps.title: Check Hy-Gard level and condition
fixSteps.instruction: Look for milky color (water) or dark (overheated).

fixSteps.title: Replace Hy-Gard and filters
fixSteps.instruction: Drain, replace return and pressure filters, refill with John Deere Hy-Gard.

fixSteps.title: Test PFC pressure
fixSteps.instruction: Service ADVISOR test ports, verify low standby and load pressure.

title: Lost Communication With Transmission Controller
shortDescription: CAN bus communication with TCU lost.
fullDescription:
IVT or PowerShift TCU communication dropped. Tractor may go to limp transmission mode.

Check CAN bus terminating resistors and harness through articulation joint on 9R.

fixSteps.title: Check CAN voltage
fixSteps.instruction: 2.5V on each line at rest, 60 ohms across CAN H/L key off.

faq.a: Usually 3rd gear forward, low road speed.

title: DEF Tank Level Low
fullDescription:
Final Tier 4 inducement starts with low warning, escalates to derate, then 5 percent power. Refill with ISO 22241 DEF promptly.

Always purchase fresh sealed DEF jugs - field-stored DEF >30C breaks down quickly.

fixSteps.title: Replace DEF header sender
fixSteps.instruction: Drain tank, swap top-mounted sender unit.

faq.a: Below 25C, away from sun, or DEF concentration drifts.
